overview: The developer describes a phased waterfront district with more than 36,000 planned homes across 100-plus apartment complexes and over 109 mansions. These are proposed programme figures, not delivered homes or available stock.

A construction release reports 39% across the first 14 released buildings, with Venice 3 at 74%, Venice 1 at 64% and Venice 2 at 57%. Those figures have a limited release scope and are not a current site inspection. A separate industry report describes a round-the-clock construction programme.
research.locationNote: Dubai South, near Emirates Road and Al Maktoum International Airport. The brochure map is illustrative; proposed transport links are not operating stations or guaranteed walking routes.
research.priceNote: Property Finder shows AED 747,000 as a launch guide. It is not a current selected-unit quotation; its displayed sold-out configurations do not establish availability across the entire community or resale market.
research.paymentNote: The historical branded sheet shows 10% booking, four further 10% instalments at 30, 150, 270 and 390 days, then 50% on completion. It carries an elapsed Q4 2025 estimate and a change notice. Property Finder instead summarises 14%/36%/50%; no document retrieved explains that difference. Confirm the selected release, fees and signed schedule.
research.handoverNote: The historical payment sheet estimates Q4 2025; Property Finder lists Q4/December 2026. Neither establishes delivery of every numbered release or the whole district. Obtain the selected building’s current contractual date, registration and readiness evidence; no completed handover is asserted.

facts.label: Planned cultural district
facts.value: The developer proposes an opera house, theatre, exhibition hall and performing arts academy. Planned attractions have separate delivery and operating milestones.

unresolved: Selected plans concern AV.BD.A003 Tower A only. Printed totals can differ by 0.01 ft² from rounded components; balconies are not enclosed accommodation. Mansions and other releases need their own plans.
Current unit prices, availability, dated offers, contractual handover, final finishes, parking, service/cooling charges and ownership terms remain unverified. Images stay illustrative.
Pools, wellness facilities, retail, school, hospital, waterpark and cultural venues are proposed facilities; no opening dates, licences, universal access or selected-unit entitlement are established.
